library.title: Find any resource in seconds, never lose one again

library.point1: Automatic: every file any tool exports is added in the background, with the tool and client version it came from.
library.point2: Search and filter: by name, game ID, category, client version, tag, format, size, date and more.
library.point3: Organize: your own categories, tags, custom fields, related assets and shareable collections.
library.point4: Duplicates: identical files, the same graphic at another size and look-alike images are reported – nothing is ever deleted for you.
library.point5: Safe: fast rescans, earlier versions of changed files, an integrity check, backup and restore – all stored locally and fully offline.

faq.title: Questions and answers
faq.a1: Yes. It is a free, independent community project with no account, no advertising and no paid features.
faq.q2: Does it change my Tibia client or my characters?
faq.a2: No. Tibia Foundry only reads the client's files. It never writes into a client folder, never touches your character, hotkeys or account, and does not interact with the game while it runs.
faq.q3: Where do the images come from, and may I publish them?
faq.a3: From the official client installed on your computer. Tibia's graphics and data are © CipSoft GmbH; Tibia Foundry writes that notice and your name as creator into every exported image. Follow CipSoft's rules for fansites and your website's own image policy.
faq.q4: Is the Asset Library uploaded anywhere?
faq.a4: No. The library is a SQLite database on your computer; your files stay where they are and are only read. Removing an asset from the library never deletes a file. Back it up or restore it from the library's Folders and storage tab.
faq.q5: Will it delete my duplicate images?
faq.a5: No. Find duplicates lists identical files, the same graphic at another size and look-alike images so you can decide what to keep. Nothing is deleted, moved or merged by the program.
faq.q6: Can I use it for my own fansite rather than TibiaWiki?
faq.a6: Yes – that is what publishing profiles are for. Create a profile with your sizes, formats, file names, folders, credit line and HTML or BBCode snippet; the TibiaWiki profile is just one example.
faq.q7: What happens after a Tibia update?
faq.a7: When it starts, Tibia Foundry checks the installed client in the background and offers to archive the new version. The Compatibility page reports how well the new files are understood, and an update-resources project renders everything new or changed since the previous version.
faq.a8: The installer for a normal installation with a Start-menu entry and uninstall; the portable edition to run it from any folder or USB stick without installing. Both are the same program.
faq.q9: Is Tibia Foundry affiliated with CipSoft or Fandom?
faq.a9: No. It is an independent community project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by CipSoft GmbH or Fandom. It is not part of CipSoft's Fansite Programme.
faq.q10: Where does the online Tibia data come from?
faq.a10: From TibiaData, a free public API built on Tibia.com. Your browser asks TibiaData directly; this website has no server of its own and keeps nothing about your searches.

today.title: Today in Tibia
today.maintenance: On maintenance days the server may come back later.

rule.nextServerSave: Every game world saves once a day at 10:00 Central European Time: CET in winter, CEST in summer, which is Berlin time. The next server save is the next 10:00 Berlin time; at exactly 10:00:00 a save has just happened, so the next one is the following day's. The countdown is the time until then, and the clock time is shown in your own time zone. On days with extended maintenance the server comes back later; that is not included.
rule.rashid: Rashid's town depends on the weekday, and the Tibia day starts at server save (10:00 Berlin time), not at midnight: until 10:00 he is still where he was the day before. Monday Svargrond, Tuesday Liberty Bay, Wednesday Port Hope, Thursday Ankrahmun, Friday Darashia, Saturday Edron, Sunday Carlin. Example: on Sunday at 09:59 Berlin time he is still in Edron; at 10:00 he is in Carlin.

guides.title: Guides and documentation
guides.lead: Get started with the program, use the online Tibia data tools and find the detailed documentation of every tool.

data.title: Using the Tibia data tools
data.lead: The Tibia Data pages show live information from TibiaData, which reads it from Tibia.com. Everything runs in your browser.

step1.title: Search
step1.text: Type a character name in the search field at the top of any page, or open Worlds, Guilds or Highscores and pick a world.

step2.title: Filter and sort
step2.text: Every table can be filtered by typing and sorted by any column; on a phone, rows become cards.

step3.title: Copy for the wiki
step3.text: Copy a name, a value or a whole table as wikitext or CSV and paste it into TibiaWiki or a spreadsheet.

step4.title: Check the original
step4.text: Every view links to the same page on Tibia.com and says when the data was fetched.

about.title: About Tibia Foundry
about.role: Creator and Developer of Tibia Foundry
about.bio1: Rocky LaRochelle created Tibia Foundry to provide useful software, tools and resources for the Tibia community, particularly for the people involved with TibiaWiki and Tibia-related content.
about.bio2: Tibia Foundry is one desktop application for the work between the installed Tibia client and a published page – sprites, animations, maps, sounds, data and wiki infoboxes. This website adds free online tools for looking up Tibia data.

project.title: The project
project.text1: Tibia Foundry is free and open source. The program, its source code and this website are published on GitHub, together with every release, its notes and its checksums.
project.text2: Bug reports and ideas are welcome as GitHub issues; questions can also be sent by email.
project.text3: Tibia Foundry is an independent community project. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by CipSoft GmbH or Fandom, and it is not part of CipSoft's Fansite Programme.

downloads.title: Downloads and safety
downloads.where: Tibia Foundry is published only on the Downloads page of tibiafoundry.com and in the releases of github.com/RockyJLaRo/TibiaFoundry. Copies from anywhere else are not official.
downloads.check1: Every package is built from the published source code by the project's own release scripts.
downloads.check2: After the build, the archives' contents are listed and compared, the program is started from the extracted files, and the SHA-256 checksums are published.
downloads.check3: The program and installer are not code-signed and no third-party malware scan is published. Nobody can guarantee that a file is free of malware – scan it yourself.
downloads.check4: Report anything suspicious to the responsible administrator by email.
downloads.purpose: Tibia Foundry reads the files of the Tibia client on your own PC to make images, animations, maps and data for TibiaWiki and fansites. It is not a bot, cheat, macro or automation tool. Its file editors (Assets Editor, RCC Editor, Client Converter) never change the installed client in place and save copies – never play on Tibia's servers with modified client files, as that breaks the Tibia Rules.

money.title: Money and advertising
money.ads: No advertisements, sponsors or sponsored content.
money.income: No donations, affiliate links, paid features or other income. Tibia Foundry and this website are free; Rocky pays for them himself.
money.hidden: No crypto mining, no hidden use of your computer, no stream view-botting and no undisclosed tracking.
money.change: If this ever changes, it will be stated here before it starts.

privacy.title: Privacy and statistics
privacy.intro: Tibia Foundry has no accounts and collects no names, email addresses or passwords. Here is everything this website does with data.
privacy.stats: This site uses Google Analytics 4 to count visits: pages viewed, approximate region, device and browser type, and clicks on download and GitHub links. Google sets cookies for this. Rocky sees only aggregated reports, and aggregated totals may be shared with CipSoft's fansite team. You can turn the statistics off for this browser:
privacy.stateUnknown: Turn on JavaScript to change this setting.
privacy.gpc: If your browser sends a Global Privacy Control signal, statistics are off automatically.
privacy.data: Your browser asks the TibiaData API (api.tibiadata.com) for the Tibia data you view, including the characters you search for, and loads game images from static.tibia.com (CipSoft). Like every website, these services see your IP address.
privacy.storage: Only on your device: your theme (tf-theme), language (tf-lang), statistics choice (tf-analytics) and last world viewed (tf-world), plus a cache of TibiaData answers that is deleted when you close the tab (tf-api). Nothing of it is sent to Tibia Foundry.
privacy.nothingTitle: What this site does not have
privacy.nothing: No accounts, no contact form, no comments, no newsletter and no advertising trackers. Emails you send are read only by Rocky.

community.title: Community rules
community.text1: This website has no forum, comments or uploads. The only public place to discuss Tibia Foundry is its GitHub issue tracker, which also follows GitHub's own rules.
community.text2: Everything published here and in the project's GitHub space must respect the Tibia Rules. Not allowed:
community.rule1: Spam, harassment, abuse or offensive content.
community.rule2: Phishing, hack links, cheat tools, bots or advertising for them.
community.rule3: Account trading, or trading characters, items or gold for real money.

hub.title: Tibia calculators
hub.lead: Plan your next levels and hunts. Every calculator shows how it works, where its numbers come from and when they were last checked.
hub.verified: Every formula is checked against an official Tibia source or TibiaWiki and at least one independent value before it is published. Results are calculated in your browser.

calc.resetDone: The calculator is back to its starting values.

error.format: This is not a number we can read. Write it like 1,500,000 or 1.5kk.
error.duration: Enter a time as hours:minutes, like 39:00.
error.tooLarge: These values give a result too large to show exactly. Use smaller numbers.
error.failed: This result cannot be calculated. Check your values.

label.shareTibiapal: for level 1 it gives 1 as the lowest level, the table 0
label.staminaTibiapal: regeneration time only, without the 10-minute logout delay
label.blessingsTibiapal: rounded to thousands of gold; not used below level 30, where it shows negative prices
label.statsGuildstats: hit points and mana only; its capacity is from before the October 2025 update
label.newsTibiaroute: TibiaRoute's copy of CipSoft's news of 15 October 2025

experience.title: Experience and level
experience.card: Experience to your target level, hunting time, finish date and party share range.
experience.lead: How much experience you need from your current level to your target level, how long that takes at your experience per hour, and who you can share experience with in a party.
experience.shareFrom: Party share range at current level
experience.shareTo: Party share range at target level

error.toAboveFrom: The target level must be higher than the current level.
error.exph: Experience per hour must be more than 0.
error.hpd: Hours per day must be a whole number from 1 to 24.

rule.levelExp: Total experience for level L = 50/3 × (L³ − 6L² + 17L − 12). A new character at level 1 has 0 experience; level 2 needs 100 and level 8 needs 4,200.
rule.levelPlan: Experience needed = total experience of the target level − total experience of the current level. Hunting time = experience needed ÷ experience per hour, in whole minutes (rounded down). Days = hunting time ÷ hours per day, rounded up; the estimated finish counts those days from today.
rule.shareRange: A party shares experience only when its levels are close enough: for level L the share range runs from ⌊2L/3⌋ to ⌊3L/2⌋ + 1 (⌊ ⌋ = rounded down), the values of TibiaWiki's Party Experience Sharing table. Example: level 100 shares with levels 66 to 151.

stamina.title: Stamina regeneration
stamina.card: Offline time to regain stamina up to 42:00, and the time you will be back at your target.
stamina.lead: How long your character has to stay logged out to go from your current stamina to your target stamina, counting the slower regeneration of the bonus hours.
stamina.hint: Write the time as hours:minutes, like 39:00. Full stamina is 42:00.
stamina.note: The first 10 minutes after you log out give no stamina; the offline time needed includes them.

error.targetAboveCurrent: The target stamina must be higher than the current stamina.

rule.staminaRest: Logged out, you regain 1 minute of stamina for every 3 minutes offline while below 39:00, and 1 minute for every 6 minutes offline from 39:00 up to the maximum of 42:00. Regeneration time = 3 × (minutes of stamina below 39:00) + 6 × (minutes of stamina from 39:00 to 42:00). Nothing is regained during the first 10 minutes after logout, so the offline time needed = regeneration time + 10 minutes. Example: 39:00 to 42:00 takes 18 hours of regeneration, 18 h 10 min offline.

blessings.title: Blessings
blessings.card: What the 5 regular blessings, the 2 enhanced blessings, Blessing of the Inquisition and Twist of Fate cost at your level.
blessings.lead: The price in gold of every death blessing at your level: regular, enhanced, the Inquisition blessing from Henricus and Twist of Fate.
blessings.hint: Levels 1 to 30 all pay the same price.
blessings.inquisition: Blessing of the Inquisition, instead of the 5 regular (gp)
blessings.note: Not included: the Phoenix Egg and Pilgrimage of Ashes discounts and Store (Tibia Coin) prices. Characters with a red or black skull pay full price.

rule.blessings: Regular blessing (each of 5): 2,000 gp up to level 30; 200 × (level − 20) from level 31 to 119; 20,000 + 75 × (level − 120) from level 120. Enhanced blessing (each of 2): 2,600 gp up to level 30; 260 × (level − 20) from level 31 to 119; 26,000 + 100 × (level − 120) from level 120. Twist of Fate: 2,000 gp up to level 30; 200 × (level − 20) from level 31 to 269; 50,000 gp from level 270. Blessing of the Inquisition (after the Inquisition quest, bought from Henricus) replaces the 5 regular blessings and costs 10% more than they do together, rounded down. Below level 8 the prices of levels up to 30 apply. Example, level 75: 5 regular blessings 55,000 gp, Inquisition 60,500 gp, each enhanced blessing 14,300 gp, Twist of Fate 11,000 gp. All 7 blessings = the 5 regular + the 2 enhanced (level 75: 83,600 gp), or Blessing of the Inquisition + the 2 enhanced (level 75: 89,100 gp); Twist of Fate is bought separately.

blessings.allSevenInquisition: All 7 with Blessing of the Inquisition (gp)

stats.title: Character stats
stats.card: Hit points, mana and capacity of your vocation at any level, including the Monk.
stats.lead: The maximum hit points, mana and capacity a character has at your level, for every vocation.
stats.vocationHint: Assumes you chose your vocation at level 8. Below level 8 every character has the no-vocation values.
stats.note: Base values without equipment, Wheel of Destiny or other bonuses. Choosing the vocation after level 8 gives lower values than shown (for example permanently less capacity for knights and paladins). Capacity includes the +200 oz base of the October 2025 update (CipSoft news, 15 October 2025), which the game only applies once a character has levelled up.

rule.characterStats: From level 1 every character has 150 hit points, 55 mana and 600 oz of capacity and gains 5 hit points, 5 mana and 10 oz per level up to level 8, so 185 / 90 / 670 at level 8. Each level after 8 adds the vocation's gain (hit points / mana / capacity): no vocation 5 / 5 / 10, knight 15 / 5 / 25, paladin 10 / 15 / 20, sorcerer and druid 5 / 30 / 10, monk 10 / 10 / 25. This assumes the vocation was chosen at level 8. Example, knight at level 100: hit points 185 + 15 × 92 = 1,565, mana 90 + 5 × 92 = 550, capacity 670 + 25 × 92 = 2,970.
